references.text: Parallel account in Joshua where Achsah comes to her father Caleb and asks for land with water springs. Same event and almost identical wording.
The daughters of Zelophehad ask for inheritance rights to land, showing that women in Israel could request and receive land areas, just as Achsah does here.
Context for the story of Achsah - Caleb gives his daughter to Othniel as a wife after he captures Kiriath-sepher.
The immediately preceding text telling about Caleb's promise to give his daughter Achsah to whoever captures Kiriath-sepher.
Rebekah dismounts from the camel when she sees Isaac, a similar action where a woman dismounts from a riding animal in an important situation.
